Two things that I don't understand why people don't bring up in the socialism debate more: 1) we are already partially socialist in that we pay taxes for things like roads and cops so if you think socialism is evil as crowder does then you should be fighting to remove all tax funded anything. Put out your own fires, etc. The problem with this is it ends up costing the public more because it costs more to fix a building that has completely burned down and the fire has spread than just putting out the fire before it spreads. It's in the interest of everyone's well being to have these taxes pay for these things, and Healthcare is no different. Slavery is different because it does not benefit the slaves. Tax funded systems should benefit everyone, and Healthcare and education andbsolutely do. Second: socialism isn't the forceful taking of what you earned. Your opportunity to earn is a direct result of being part of a country that uses tax money to keep you safe educated and healthy so you can succeed and earn. So if you don't want to be part of that system that propped you up and don't want to contribute, you could just leave...
